annotations.text:
Chosen 2026-08-24.

The mark is the Today nav glyph from web/index.html, scaled exactly into a 512 box: r 8.5 → 181, stroke 1.9 → 40.5, hands 12→4.5. Nothing about it is new artwork, which is the point — the home screen and the rail show the same object.

Ground oklch(0.215 0.018 55), stroke oklch(0.66 0.19 330), both lifted from web/src/styles.css.

Considered and passed over on 2026-08-24. Kept so the choice is not re-argued from memory later.

A · Monogram — needs its letterforms outlined to ship, and WD belongs to a hundred other apps.
C · Split — the hues belong to whichever instances an install happens to have.
D · Ring — an arc implies a daily target this app does not have.
